method: Remove only whole rules when every selector begins with an explicitly absent component class. Preserve declaration and cascade bytes. Do not use first-viewport coverage.
runtime_review: HTML, shared module sources and bundle, inline tool code, static and conditional imports reviewed together. A changed source hash requires component review before regeneration. Firebase entry and bundler are covered; provider SDK does not create the reviewed site component classes. PR #825 integration review (a2516631f0282e0274b5afd44e280a965a1984ec against main de81f1be7b409d765a7cf4d76ef6ca619e138f8b): the diagnostic HTML adds dates and the tool-export-terms paragraph; tool-credits adds an existing wallet action and preserves export-result identity; showcase reveals export terms and filters existing catalogue cards. Imports remain unchanged. The added tool-export-terms class and existing wallet actions remain covered by the loaded diagnostic and wallet stylesheets; no excluded base component was introduced. All 14 runtime sources were checked against the unchanged 266 exclusions, and the projected CSS remains byte-identical. PR #848 component review (2026-11-19, source candidate 4f2fcefb36e57526495af8f9ebf3800b403ecf04 against main 07b84328c8c0ef563fc2983679f8bc0c1fa1287e): diagnostic export handlers capture the prepared text and call the existing wallet module; resumed exports use existing dialog elements. The temporary print frame, print document and preformatted text have explicit rules in the wallet stylesheet loaded by that module. Catalogue price and explanation classes are scoped to the catalogue and remain inactive on this diagnostic route. Analytics changes add finite event dimensions and no DOM components. Existing module import paths and conditional Firebase imports are unchanged. Root and an independent reviewer checked all 14 runtime sources against the unchanged 266 component exclusions; no excluded component occurs. The canonical base CSS and its projected stylesheet remain byte-identical. PR #850 component review (2026-11-19, against cce3f3c657e0d30fc282234097f84b31cf23a768): the shared click handler classifies local tool-result buttons as tool_action, preserving explicit form, contact and offer actions. The change introduces no DOM components, styles, imports or dynamic markup. The principal agent checked all 14 runtime sources against the unchanged 266 component exclusions; none occurs. Only nav.js and its generated script.js bundle change their source hashes. The canonical base CSS and projected diagnostic stylesheet remain byte-identical. SEO and contextual conversion review (2026-11-19, against main 44b3897167febcc61bcfb0dadf1147d8c2f75b31): analytics adds only the existing /cad/ and /bim/ path prefixes to the tool source family. No DOM, selector, style, import, dynamic markup or event transport is added. The principal agent checked all 14 runtime sources against the unchanged 266 component exclusions; none occurs. Only analytics.js and its deterministic script.js assembly change their hashes. The base stylesheet and diagnostic projection are unchanged. PR #858 revisao de componentes (2026-11-20/21, contra main d956b4994d7f37de8989635fb36f05321f8d48d2): a revisao do acesso da carteira alterou exclusivamente assets/js/tool-credits.mjs entre as 14 fontes de runtime do diagnostico. O modulo continua com os mesmos imports e adiciona classes locais tool-credits__auth-* na interface de autenticacao, acompanhadas por regras isoladas em assets/css/tool-credits.css. A interface fica em dialog especifico e nao cria nenhuma classe excluida do CSS base da rota de diagnostico. A varredura literal de todas as 266 classes excluidas no modulo revisado encontrou zero ocorrencias; as outras 13 fontes mantiveram seus hashes. O CSS base styles.css e a projecao diagnostico-base.css permanecem inalterados. O hash a seguir corresponde aos bytes verificados do modulo, e nao dispensa os testes automaticos e a paridade visual. PR #860 revisão dirigida de componentes (2026-11-21): script.js e js/modules/analytics.js acrescentam somente o identificador literal planilhas-engenharia às listas fechadas de ferramentas comerciais. A comparação dos blobs com main mostrou ausência de qualquer outra alteração de código, DOM, HTML, importações, folhas CSS ou seletores de componentes. O identificador novo não coincide com nenhuma das 266 classes explicitamente excluídas da projeção do diagnóstico e não altera componentes renderizados na rota de diagnóstico. Apenas os hashes dessas duas fontes são recapturados; as outras 12 fontes, a lista de classes, a folha canônica e a projeção CSS continuam inalteradas. A verificação de ausência de classes excluídas e o teste de paridade visual permanecem obrigatórios. Revisao conjunta #859/#860 em 21/11/2026: inclusao simultanea de bim-editor-ifc e planilhas-engenharia nas listas finitas de ferramentas da fonte e do bundle, sem DOM, imports, seletores ou classes novas na rota de diagnostico. Preservadas as 266 exclusoes e a projecao CSS.
